"},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenMOSS 团队发布 MOSS-TTS-v1.5 与音效生成模型 MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

SpaceXAI 针对用户反馈 Grok Build Beta 迅速触达限制的问题，改进了相关 缓存机制 ，并已重置所有账户的该功能使用额度。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

OpenCode Go 套餐现已支持 Qwen3.7 Max 模型，仅限纯文本且提供 100 万 上下文。 Arena.ai 称该模型在 Code Arena 首秀排第四。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"美团发布面向 AI Agent 的跑腿下单助手 Skill"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
美团 发布面向 AI Agent 的 跑腿下单助手 。该 Skill 支持直接调用 美团 跑腿接口完成 帮取送 、 帮忙 和 帮买 等场景，并内置地址搜索与订单查询功能。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"支付宝推出全栈AI支付体系及首个Token Pay服务"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
蚂蚁集团 旗下 支付宝 正式发布由 AI付 、 AI收 、 Token Pay 和 AI钱包 构成的 AI支付 “全家桶”，建立覆盖授权、支付、结算和管理的全栈 AI原生支付体系 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

秘塔AI搜索 近期宣布扩容视频库 十倍 ，提升搜索速度与深度，并新增 “事实核验” 功能，支持比对多方来源判断信息真伪，现已面向 PC端 开放。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Datacurve 发布 DeepSWE 长周期软件工程基准"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Datacurve 团队推出软件工程基准 DeepSWE ，含 91 个仓库的 113 项原创长周期任务，官方评测显示 gpt-5.5 以 70% 通过率排名第一。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/","text":"https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"16. "},{"tag":"text","text":"蚂蚁集团与新加坡国立大学团队提出KPop训练方法"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
蚂蚁集团 等联合提出 KPop 方法，使用 自适应二元KL 散度 替代 固定比率约束 ，以解决大规模 MoE 模型 强化学习 训练中的 训练 - 推理不匹配问 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://ringtech.notion.site/kpop","text":"https://ringtech.notion.site/kpop"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"行业动态"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"17. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenRouter 宣布完成 1.13 亿美元融资"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenRouter 宣布完成 1.13 亿美元 B 轮 融资，本轮融资由 Alphabet 旗下的 CapitalG 领投。官方数据显示，该平台每周处理的 token 量已增长至 25 万亿 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"MiniMax预热M3模型及MSA稀疏注意力架构"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
MiniMax 近日预告了 M3 模型及其使用的稀疏注意力架构 MiniMax Sparse Attention 。官方数据显示，在 100 万 token 长文本下， M3 预填充速度较前代 M2 提升 9.7 倍，解码速度提升 15.6 倍。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/MiniMax_AI/status/2059286515155599595","text":"https://x.com/MiniMax_AI/status/2059286515155599595"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Paper"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"1. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文提出SAERL框架，利用稀疏自编码器从LLM内部提取多样性、难度和质量三种内在信号，用于强化学习微调中的数据工程（如批次多样性控制、课程排序和数据过滤），在数学推理任务上以更少训练步数实现3%的准确率提升，并验证了跨模型和尺度的轻量可复用性。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27354","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27354"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"2. "},{"tag":"text","text":"DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
DEI提出异构大语言模型分布式质量多样性搜索框架，将不同模型作为变异算子通过节点对抗提升搜索，在核心战争上四模型异构集成以相同预算下提升124% QD-Score和28%覆盖率，首次证明模型多样性是关键动力。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27130","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27130"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"3. "},{"tag":"text","text":"LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}]]}

{"title":"Daily AI Info (2/2)","elements":[[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文提出统一生成式定位框架LocateAnything，采用并行框解码（PBD）将边界框作为原子单元一步生成，保持几何一致性并大幅提升解码吞吐量，同时构建包含1.38亿样本的大规模数据集，在多种基准上实现高IoU定位的速度与精度双重提升。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27365","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27365"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"4. "},{"tag":"text","text":"MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
提出MUSE-Autoskill Agent框架，让代理通过创建、存储、管理、测试和精炼技能持续提升任务解决能力，并引入技能级记忆积累跨任务经验，在SkillsBench上验证了生命周期管理技能能提高成功率、效率和复用性，突出技能作为可测试、经验丰富的长期资产的重要性。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27366","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27366"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"5. "},{"tag":"text","text":"LitSeg: Narrative-Aware Document Segmentation for Literary RAG"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文提出叙事感知的文档分割框架LitSeg，通过多阶段提示提取事件与转折点来优化文学作品的RAG检索，并进一步通过数据蒸馏训练轻量级单步分割模型LitSeg-Lite，显著提升分割块的结构独立性和下游问答准确率。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27156","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27156"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"6. "},{"tag":"text","text":"ENPMR-Bench: Benchmarking Proactive Memory Retrieval for Emotional Support Agents"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该论文构建了ENPMR-Bench基准，包含1800多个对话，基于马斯洛需求模型定义情感需求与支持性记忆类型映射，评测发现现有检索方法共情得分远低于理想记忆，提示需增强代理对潜在情感需求的主动前瞻记忆检索能力。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27240","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27240"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"7. "},{"tag":"text","text":"EviACT: An Evidence-to-Action Framework for Agentic Program Repair"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
提出EviACT框架，通过检索脚手架、编译门和测试驱动门三个证据驱动护栏协调agentic程序修复各阶段，在四个基准上相比最强基线提升1.6-6.0个百分点修复率，并降低70.1-88.6%的API成本，为高效可靠的自修复代理提供新方案。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27238","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27238"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"8. "},{"tag":"text","text":"MATCHA: Matching Text via Contrastive Semantic Alignment"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
MATCHA提出一种文本匹配度量，通过对比语义对齐，同时奖励与参考文本的语义接近度并惩罚与对抗生成反事实的矛盾，在8个公开基准上优于ROUGE和BERTScore，尤其在TruthfulQA上提升18.38%，并公开代码可集成于评估流程。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27345","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27345"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"9. "},{"tag":"text","text":"EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
EdgeFlow通过将Canny边缘图作为结构先验增强VLM输入，无训练地将工业流程图转为Mermaid模型，在IndusReqFlow数据集上节点、边缘、路径F1分别提升17.39、16.94、11.06个百分点，并提供数据集，有效支持基于模型的测试。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27332","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27332"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"10. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Lost in Sampling: Assessing Lexical Reachability in LLMs via the Word Coverage Score (WCS)"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-05-26"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
针对LLM输出重复问题，该论文提出词覆盖率得分（WCS）指标，在人类语料上审计开源模型解码过程，发现默认Top-p、Top-k等采样参数会修剪低频高信息词汇，导致语言同质化，为优化连贯性与丰富度权衡提供诊断框架。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27268","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27268"}]]}
